जेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be conquered or overcome,
conquerable, vincible; to be surpassed.

जेतृ जेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ (fr. rt. 1. जि), victorious,
[]
triumphant; surpassing, excelling; gaining; (ता),
m. a victor, conqueror; N. of a Vedic poet who was
son of Madhu-cchandas; N. of a prince who had a
garden near Śrāvastī in which Śākya-muni pro-
mulgated his doctrines.
—जेत-वन, अम्, n. (for
जेतृ+वन), the wood of Jetṛ, N. of a grove or
garden near Śrāvastī where Śākya-muni or Buddha
promulgated his doctrines.
—जेतवनीय, आस्, m. pl.
N. of a Buddhist school.
—जेत-साह्वय, अस्, आ, अम्,
called after Jetṛ.
—जेताराम, अस्, m. (for जेतृ+
आर्˚), = जेत-वन.
जेत्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be gained or conquered.
